text:
lina: Marinera Financial dedicated rollout prep - changing to v2.1.3-quant. Change window proposed: 2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need biz/security/ops thumbs-up and rollback plan.

jess: +1 on window from product side. Can we pin the model and disable automatic auto-scale for first hour?

mike: We should pin. Suggest config: `model: redwood/marinera-v2.1.3-quant`, `autoscale: manual`, `canary: 5%` for 30m. If errors spike, immediate rollback.

anika: Ops: listing rollback triggers: 1) error rate > 2% sustained 5m, 2) 99th latency > 1.2s sustained 5m, 3) customer-reported functional regressions via support channel. Agree on alerting to #incidents and paging.

deploy-bot: preflight checks started for customer=marinera env=dedicated version=v2.1.3-quant

```
deploy-bot: git-ref: refs/tags/v2.1.3-quant
deploy-bot: image-sha: sha256:8b3f...c1a2
deploy-bot: canary-config: 5% for 30m
deploy-bot: health-checks: OK (smoke x3)
```

lina: Thanks deploy-bot. Do we have rollout runbook link?

mike: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/marinera-dedicated-rollout (private). Key steps in case of rollback: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --customer marinera --to v2.1.2 --force` and `redwoodctl route set --customer marinera --percent 100 --version v2.1.2`.

jess: Security note: confirm KMS keys are bound to dedicated cluster (ops already validated in staging).

ops_bot: KMS check: OK. Audit log enabled.

anika: Schedule pinned to 02:00 UTC. I'll book the incident rotation and make sure SRE on-call is present. Who will drive the canary observation?

mike: I'll monitor telemetry (latency/cpu/error) and have dashboards up. Set alerts: `error_rate_p50 > 0.5%` and `error_rate_p99 > 1%` (soft), `error_rate_over_2pct` (hard).

lina: Decision: pin to v2.1.3-quant, canary 5% 30m, manual autoscale for first hour, rollback triggers as listed. Approvals: product:jess, ops:anika, sres:mike. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.

jess: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

anika: :thumbsup:

release-bot: Release scheduled for 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z. Notifying customer contacts.

lina: I'll post pre-rollout notes in #customer-success and attach the short release-notes snippet: "v2.1.3-quant: latency optimizations for sequence lengths <1024, improved KV caching, minor tokenizer fix. No prompt-surface behavior changes expected."

jess: Suggest adding a small eval prompt-set to run during canary to detect subtle regressions — I'll add 20 prompts.

mike: Good call. Add them to canary-runner under `canary/marinera/quick-evals` before 01:30 UTC.

lina: All set. Will escalate if any alert hits hard thresholds. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment job created: job_id=deploy-1795554321-01 (will execute at 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z)
